targets.authors: Spreng R. N. & Grady C. L.
targets.title: Patterns of brain activity supporting autobiographical memory, prospection, and theory of mind, and their relationship to the default mode network.
targets.evidence_quote: To address this, Spreng and Grady 7 developed a novel paradigm combining autobiographical memory, prospection and theory of mind conditions, and identified both common and distinct patterns of activation within the default network. Here we share data supporting a replication of this high impact neuroimaging experiment in a new subject cohort using a novel, multi-echo neuroimaging sequence.
targets.outcome_quote: In this new sample, the findings from the original report are successfully replicated using the same analysis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that the original results are successfully replicated; technical validation also confirms replicability.
